2120858856284725536.en_summary: $LUNR Intuitive Machines beat on Q3: Revenue $269M vs $245.9M consensus, EPS -$0.02 vs -$0.10 expected. Adjusted EBITDA turned positive at $8.3M, free cash flow was +$33M. Backlog hit a record $1.87B. FY26 revenue guide narrowed to $920–950M (was $900M–$1.0B).
2120858856284725536.zh_summary: $LUNR Intuitive Machines Q3 超預期：收入 2.69 億美元對比共識 2.459 億美元，EPS -0.02 對比預期 -0.10。調整後 EBITDA 轉正至 830 萬美元，自由現金流 +3300 萬美元。積壓訂單創紀錄達 18.7 億美元。FY26 收入指引收窄至 9.20–9.50 億（原為 9 億–10 億）。

ticker_notes.LUNR: beat on revenue and EPS, positive adjusted EBITDA and FCF, record backlog
